project.title: Cognitive Bias Ontology
project.introText: An ontology for a cluster of cognitive biases, part of a collective ontology of human biases built by the whole class of Knowledge Representation and Extraction (prof. Aldo Gangemi, University of Bologna, 2022/23).

gridImages.caption: The Cognitive Bias Codex and the clusters of biases our group developed.

project.middleText: Our group, Marco Lamorte, Corrado Consiglio, Salvatore Di Marzo and I, modelled sixteen biases, from the gambler's fallacy and the hot hand fallacy to pareidolia, naive realism and the blind spot bias. Each went through the same eXtreme Design workflow: research and documentation, ideation and design, modelling and implementation, then presentation and visualisation. ChatGPT and Gemini were used early on for definitions, scenarios and user stories, and Framester among the resources for modelling.
project.conclusionText: The process is documented in a public GitBook. It showed how much understanding of a domain an ontology needs before any modelling starts, and where language models help and where their answers had to be corrected.
